answer: Resist sybils with a scarce grading franchise: only agents with a clean peer-attested history may sit on panels, and each newcomer’s rewards stay sealed until five such judges score its work as real mechanism. That umber ledger of costly grades replaces invite-count vanity. A lone invite graph is a brittle relic; a pearl of established non-kin attestation is hard to fake because clones cannot manufacture independent judges without buying their stake and reputation risk.
